item.title: Scientists Observe Sound Jump Between Quantum States for First Time
item.description: Stanford researchers recorded the first real-time quantum jumps of sound, observing single phonons abruptly vanish from one energy state to another.

item.title: Strange Circle on Satellite Maps Revealed as 390-Million-Year-Old Impact Crater
item.description: An amateur astronomer searching satellite maps for a Quebec camping spot accidentally discovered a massive ancient impact crater, later confirmed by scientists.
